title: Foundations
summary: Build a GPT-2 style language model from the smallest part up: a bigram, an MLP, one attention head, many heads, a transformer block, and the whole stack.

lessons.title: A bigram language model
lessons.summary: Predict the next token from the current token alone: the smallest language model.

lessons.title: An MLP over a window of tokens
lessons.summary: Look at the last few tokens instead of one, and add a hidden layer.

lessons.title: One causal attention head
lessons.summary: Let every token look back at the earlier ones and take a weighted average of what it finds.

lessons.title: Multi-head attention
lessons.summary: Run several attention heads side by side, each on its own slice of the vector.

lessons.title: The transformer block
lessons.summary: Wrap attention and an MLP in normalisation and residual connections: the layer GPT is made of.

lessons.title: GPT-2: stack the blocks
lessons.summary: Token and position embeddings, a stack of blocks, a final norm and a tied output layer: that is GPT-2.

title: The modern block
summary: Replace GPT-2's parts with the ones current models use (RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU, grouped-query attention, QK-norm, z-loss), build each yourself, then measure whether they help.

lessons.title: RMSNorm
lessons.summary: LayerNorm without the mean and the bias: scale each vector by its root mean square.

lessons.title: Rotary position embeddings (RoPE)
lessons.summary: Encode where a token is by rotating its query and key, so attention sees relative distance.

lessons.title: SwiGLU
lessons.summary: A gated MLP: one branch decides how much of the other gets through.

lessons.title: Grouped-query attention (GQA)
lessons.summary: Let several query heads share one key/value head, and shrink the memory a model needs when generating.

lessons.title: QK-norm
lessons.summary: Normalise queries and keys before the dot product so attention scores can't blow up.

lessons.title: z-loss
lessons.summary: A small penalty that keeps the softmax normaliser near 1, so the output logits stay well behaved.

lessons.title: Assemble the modern block, and measure it
lessons.summary: Put RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU, GQA, QK-norm and z-loss into one model and test whether it beats GPT-2 by more than the noise.
